system.description: Beginning at 1st level you realize that a shinobi’s strength doesn’t lie in raw power or hyper specialization. It lies in flexibility, adaptation, and awareness in the world around them. This evolving awareness sets you apart from more specialized shinobi, for when others rely on a single discipline, you walk the winding path of versatility. Choose a Shinobi Path below. You gain an additional choice at 11th level.
